title: RelConLang Experimental Semantics
establishedFindings: FOUR values require an indexed cell/fiber interpretation
current ta mapping is inconsistent between RelConLang stance data and manifest
illocutionary force is implemented as meme transformation, not a bijection with FOUR
dialogue particles are parsed but dialogue force is not preserved by discourseStateOfForest
current dialogue tests rely on hand-authored move/respondsTo/adjacency metadata

repair spans distinct layers: ren lexical act, ri replacement marking, current communicating repair diagnostics, current SignCraft contradiction substrate, and archival—not executable—affirm/retract/acknowledge adjudication theory
CoordinationCohomology.H1rank is cycle rank and is not a generic contradiction-repair metric
semantic, temporal, and dialogue graphs must be distinguished
the RelConLang manifest's Chu matrix models particle × truth/falsity-state → charge, which is richer than the flat witnessJournal particle → charge mapping
dialogue adjacency creates conditional relevance; it must not be silently treated as a deontic obligation
Player/Opponent handedness duality swaps recv/send and observe/actuate coordinates; it does not justify potential→active as message receipt
RelConLang already factors coarse Searlean force features from fine dialogue-move features; the experimental schema must preserve both
RelConLang aspect suffixes are regex-productive morphology; current parser acceptance does not require a declared lexical root and does not prove a bridge to mathematical settling

presupposition detection and the presuppose morphism currently assign different FOUR readings; the presuppose morphism's stable/both-sided witness is not ordinary 'established truth' under canonical FOUR
ga/do/ve are admitted through the legacy determiner bucket; ta/na/sha/mu are in both determiner and auxiliary buckets but closed-class precedence makes them determiners
manifest witnessJournal charge rows are receipts, not parser semantics: current stance tests do not demonstrate that FOUR particles charge propositions

roleStrategies already enumerate generic particle markers, but Proposal.rule provenance is discarded before the settled ParseResult, so explicit ga/do support is not currently distinguishable from positional inference downstream
no current communicating implementation was found for QUD/conditional-relevance state; this must remain separate from both common ground and deontic obligation

current reference resolution grounds only third-person anaphora; first/second-person RelConLang pronouns are not bound to speaker/addressee context, making several legacy dialogue gold relations deictically provisional
current roles/logicalForm can separate simple predicate-argument contrasts but do not provide a general RelConLang proposition identity relation
headline communicating read() omits several semantic readers exported by understanding, including polarity, scope, temporal, presuppositions, and logicalForm
RelConLang agency/modality verbs have parser features and manifest metadata, but no current generic semantic consumer was found for their intended speech-act/modality meanings

knowledge-joining each RelConLang particle's Chu row reproduces the stance-system table, but this projection is not semantically privileged; standard relation state-extension and non-bottom occupancy yield different interpretations
rootPatternRules attach root/template metadata to recognized noun-like surfaces, but no current generator derives noun↔verb siblings or arbitrary root+template forms

current @red-cup-engineering/signcraft includes a normalized RelConLang intake with canonical verb roots, separate aspect, clause readings, oblique rows, and ccomp event links; it moved to the standalone SignStuff library on 2026-10-01
the historical FCA saturation result used full-corpus hand-authored expect.features as side information, so closure-with-features was transductive rather than strictly train-only
current SignCell stores evidence-for/evidence-against witness sets and derives FOUR readings; it does not store a FOUR value beside a cell
shared communicating and specialized SignCraft are distinct current RelConLang reading instruments and should be compared through a shared semantic projection rather than prematurely unified

nes is a lexical predicate rather than a proposition-polarity operator in current SignCraft; no current RelConLang surface form has been demonstrated to contribute an active/against-only proposition reading
candidate stance semantics: parse stance as an utterance-supported report about a proposition, not as automatic for/against evidence on the target proposition
the manifest Chu receipt checks structural dual involution only; it does not validate the linguistic semantics of the RelConLang matrix

SignCraft already has a denial lane that derives active/stable from separate negative incidence; RelConLang can test nes+ccomp as a denial-report construction without inventing an active stance particle

legacy dialogue fixtures reuse tu across speaker changes and therefore do not preserve referents under the manifest's documented second-person deixis; v0.2 supplies corrected speaker/addressee-grounded gold

documented provenance-before-stance example is accepted by the shared grammar strategy but predicted to be refused by current SignCraft because its stance/dialogue prefield is consumed only before clause parsing

current source dialogue tests validate hand-authored pair labels rather than infer them; blind evaluation therefore needs explicit transition laws and separate scoring of move, target, compatibility, state transition, and evidence effects
candidate repair semantics mirrors stance/denial separation: language produces a repair report; evidence-state mutation requires a separate explicitly warranted transition
ku is a machine-readable grammatical question marker in both current parsers; sentence-final ? is currently only orthographic/segmentation evidence and does not create dialogue:question force
the documented ko tu kan kano? example is contrastive in parser semantics but not currently a machine-readable question because it lacks ku
fi/ko/ma/ri are local information-structure readings today; a cross-turn question-under-discussion state remains experimental
current RelConLang language package exposes decode/read/articulate/settle but no concrete structure-to-surface realization codec
current SignCraft speak() generates only explicit-role simple transitive clauses and should be treated as a saturation generator, not a general RelConLang realizer
RelConLang register tests are fixture-level constraints, not register inference or realization
shared communicating register fiber already separates register from evidentiality/style/genre; the current proof fixture's sha should not be generalized into proof=contradiction stance
current SignCraft assigns potential to unmarked clauses, but no recovered language rule establishes implicit ta; SignStuff evidence itself defaults absent cells to absurd/no evidence
language-internal documentation supports zero marking = no explicit stance report rather than implicit ta
ACT/Actively glosses for ta are stale documentary lineage after the 2026-09-02 correction establishing ta=potential and dropping a surface active particle

SignCraft subject/object fibers are stance-insensitive attested saturation/selectional incidence, not proposition truth evidence: even mu/absurd and sha/contradicted clauses populate positive hole fibers
current SignCraft speak() erases source clause stance at emission time: stance-marked corpus cells feed stance-insensitive predicate/role sampling and simple unmarked output

SignCraft inference generate(), SignCraft RelConLang speak(), and future RelConLang realization are three distinct generation planes with different inputs, outputs, evidence sensitivity, and receipt meanings

SignCraft inference settlement is signed, but current inference generate() only proposes positive/potential attribute continuations; negative evidence constrains generation without originating negative candidate moves
nextExperiment: run the dual-parser differential on blind-dialogue-v0.2, then score proposition nucleus, stance report, dialogue move, conditional relevance, and candidate denial/refusal semantics separately

maturityPolicy: Report maturity by layer (surface, morphosyntax, dependency, semantics, cross-turn dynamics, math receipt, provenance), never with an unqualified Built+green label.
